Applicant :- Smt. Foolmati

And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Suresh Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pushpila Bisht Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Case called out.
No one is present for the complainant.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

The present application under Section 438 Cr.PC./482 BNSS has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case crime No. 1304/2021, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 120-B IPC, Police Station- B. K. T.,
District- Lucknow.

From perusal of the order sheet, it appears that on 13.01.2025, the following order was passed wherein the present applicant has been granted interim anticipatory bail:-
"1.
Heard Sri Suresh Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Nirmal Kumar Pandey, learned A.G.A.for the State.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case as she has not committed any offence as alleged.
It is further stated that one piece of land has been purchased by the applicant on 25.06.2004.
Since then, she is in possession of the aforesaid land.
Even the required exercise of mutation has been carried out on 08.02.2005.

After the death of her husband on 13.04.20013, one stranger who is opposite party No. 2 has filed a complaint in the year 2021 in respect of the land in question without having any basis to file such complaint.
In such complaint, the applicant has been summoned.
Now the bailable warrant has been issued against the applicant.
It is stated that the applicant is a simple illiterate lady and she is a widow.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant undertakes that she shall co-operate in the investigation proceedings and shall not misuse the liberty of anticipatory bail, if so granted by this Court.
6. Learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the aforesaid prayer for bail but could not dispute the factual position.

7. Therefore, without entering into the merits of the issue and considering the submission that the applicant is a an illiterate lady and is a widow.; the undertaking by the applicant that she shall co-operate in the investigation and she shall not misuse the liberty of anticipatory bail, I find it appropriate that liberty of the applicant may be protected till the next date of listing.

10. List this case in the week commencing 24.02.2025.
11.
Let counter affidavit may be filed within a period of four weeks"
From perusal of the order dated 13.1.2025, it transpires that learned State Counsel was directed to file counter affidavit but the same has not been filed as yet.
Learned State Counsel has failed to demonstrate that there is any adversarial fact which are pleaded in the bail application.
This Court finds that the applicant was enlarged on an interim anticipatory bail after thoroughly considering the merits of the case.

The learned counsel for the State has also failed to submit any fact that the applicant is not cooperating with the investigation proceedings or otherwise any glaring fact which can adversely affect the merit of the case.
